requirement.description: The lookup_domain method in the Design class has incorrect domain resolution logic that leads to comparing different ClockDomain instances with the same name but different objects, causing the assertion failure in DomainLookupTestCase.
requirement.contract: The lookup_domain method must correctly resolve domain references by comparing the actual domain objects rather than relying on object identity comparisons that fail due to domain instantiation differences.

requirement.description: Simulator testbench functions are missing the required 'ctx' parameter in their function signatures, causing TypeError when running regression tests.
requirement.contract: Simulator testbench functions must accept a 'ctx' parameter as their first argument to be compatible with the simulator's execution model.

requirement.description: The lookup_domain method's fallback logic incorrectly handles domain lookups when domains are defined in different fragments, causing the assertion to fail when comparing domain objects that should be equivalent.
requirement.contract: The lookup_domain method must properly handle domain resolution by checking domain equivalence rather than object identity, particularly when dealing with renamed domains in hierarchical designs.
